name: SVG Dimensions Checker
description: Inspect SVG intrinsic width, height, units, viewBox dimensions and aspect ratio locally without rasterizing the vector artwork.
search_intent: Inspect an SVG file or SVG dimensions to understand its intrinsic dimensions, viewBox and coordinate aspect ratio.
calculation: Parse SVG root width, height and viewBox attributes safely without executing SVG scripts. Report declared absolute or relative units honestly. Calculate viewBox dimensions and aspect ratio when available. Do not present vector artwork as having an intrinsic raster DPI and do not duplicate the generic Image Print Size Calculator.
